The '''Reconstructed Combat Arena''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] combat arena located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruhnuk]]. It was the main base of the [[Hidden Chain]] during the [[Third Galactic War]] and the site of the final battle of the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]].<ref name="TOR:SoR" />
